dict.string: My Story uses Face ID to keep your journal private when app lock is turned on.
My Story turns your spoken words into text for a journal entry, entirely on this device.
My Story records your voice only to transcribe it into a journal entry; the audio itself is never saved.
My Story reads your steps, distance, and workouts to fill in a quiet day's digest when you don't write one yourself.
My Story reads events you attended to fill in a day's digest and to suggest who you were with.
My Story counts the photos you took each day to fill in a digest — it never reads or uploads the photos themselves.
My Story notes the places you visit to fill in a day's digest when you don't write one yourself.
My Story notes the places you visit, even when closed, to fill in a day's digest when you don't write one yourself.
My Story uses your exact location, only when you ask, to note precisely where a moment happened.
